summary: Point occurrences with some counts are open at very large scale (GBIF 3,887,469,368 records; eBird Observation Dataset via GBIF 1,672,931,106; OBIS 245,030,035 with depth), which would support range and overlap-width estimates, but standardized abundance toward range edges lives in the eBird Basic Dataset behind a login and was not inspectable. Small deposited sister-species range tables exist (Dryad 7qj70, 6qg3g) but none gives edge abundance profiles or a general list of representative pairs.
next_step: Request the eBird Basic Dataset for a few avian pairs and use OTL or a sister-pair table (Dryad 10.5061/dryad.7qj70) to choose pairs; pre-register overlap width as a share of range width at a stated grid resolution and an edge-decline metric with effort covariates.
obstacles_confirmed: eBird data downloads sit behind a login.
GBIF occurrence density reflects observer effort, not abundance.
Abundance toward range edges is available only for birds in the sources found.
